pr.body:
## Summary
- add repo-owned Dopemux Mission Control Codex plugin distribution
- add Codex session cwd fallback to the Task Orchestrator stdio launcher
- preserve env and git cwd precedence for project-root resolution
- document the Codex fallback behavior and validation path

## Validation
- python -m jsonschema -i task-packets/TP-DMX-MCP-CODEX-PROJECT-ROOT-FALLBACK-001.json docs/03-reference/spec/dopetask/dopetask-canonical-spec.json
- uv run --extra test pytest tests/unit/test_task_orchestrator_launcher.py
- plugins/dopemux-mission-control/scripts/task-orchestrator-current-stdio.sh --print-resolution
- /Users/hue/plugins/dopemux-mission-control/scripts/task-orchestrator-current-stdio.sh --print-resolution
- git diff --check

steps.task: Inspect launcher root resolution, Codex config, Codex session metadata, existing Task Orchestrator docs, and prior repo-scoped packet.
requirements: Do not change Task Orchestrator container image or upstream MCP tool contracts.
Do not weaken explicit env or git cwd resolution.

steps.task: Add a repo-owned plugin distribution, Codex-session cwd fallback to the launcher, and a regression test covering non-git cwd startup without explicit env.
requirements: Fallback must only run after explicit env and current git cwd detection fail.
Fallback must require an existing directory from Codex session metadata.
Fallback must preserve repo-scoped project identity via git common dir when the session cwd is a linked worktree.
validation: Regression test fails before launcher patch and passes after launcher patch.

steps.task: Validate packet schema, regression test, live print-resolution paths, diff scope, and git cleanliness.
requirements: Report any integration MCP restart limitation as NOT_RUN or residual risk.
Do not claim the already-open Codex MCP transport was restarted unless directly observed.
validation: Proof notes and final response include PASS, FAIL, and NOT_RUN truthfully.
